name: @cver/coral-sponsor
description: REEF with Sponsor — the sponsor block: a few suggested amounts, a field the visitor types into, one button. Client (sponsor.js) is BUILT from sponsor-client.mjs + sponsor-core.mjs. Deliberately NOT the cta section: a generic action button has a destination, this has an AMOUNT, and the amount is the whole shape. It collects the amount and asks the feelreef backend for a link — no payment provider code lives here, so adding a rail is never an edit to this coral. Version covers the UNIT: client JS + the data-* attribute API + the request body it sends + the --gd-* token contract.
